title: Theme
description: User theme configuration for board colors and piece rendering

mode.description: Rendering mode: colored circles with letters or SVG graphics

white_fill.description: Circle mode: fill color for white pieces

black_fill.description: Circle mode: fill color for black pieces

white_text.description: Circle mode: text color for white pieces

black_text.description: Circle mode: text color for black pieces

svg_base_path.description: SVG mode: URL prefix for piece SVGs (e.g. /standard-theme)

white_tint.description: SVG mode: tint color applied to white pieces

black_tint.description: SVG mode: tint color applied to black pieces
